scripts.dev:client: bun run build:serializers && bun run --cwd vite dev
scripts.dev:server: bun run build:serializers && bun run --cwd server dev
scripts.build: bun run build:serializers && bun run --cwd vite build && bun run --cwd server copy-fe && bun run --cwd server build-ts
scripts.test: bun run build:serializers && bun run --cwd firestore-serializers test && bun run --cwd vite test
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun run --cwd e2e test
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:serializers && tsc --noEmit -p vite && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p firestore-serializers
